Title: Failed mast: VK6RBX and the site internet link off air
Update: First reported by VK6BAD on 3 Oct: VK6RBX not replying. A site inspection found the mast had failed. Site power is fine and monitored. Partial restoration on a temporary mast is planned; no date set yet.

Title: Link drops out in hot afternoons
Update: Linked overs break up after 2 pm on warm days. Antenna alignment check planned.

Title: Beacon off air for a new keyer
Update: New keyer being built; back on air in about two weeks.

Title: Link down after a firmware update
Update: Rolled back to the previous firmware on 16 Oct.
